Joint beta/conditional-binomial CLT gives N(0,1+ρ) versus N(0,1); because maximizing signed interval is exact for each n and weak normal cdfs converge uniformly, critical TV tends to F(ρ). For ρ→∞ beta variation on scale n/sqrt(A) dominates sqrt(n) binomial noise, giving TV→1. For ρ→0 beta third moment Taylor in global l1 has error O((n/A)^(3/2)+(n/A)^2) and second derivative norm gives e^-1/2/sqrt(2π); the analytic estimates justify joint n,A limit, not finite samples.
